comparison.objective: React to randomly illuminated buttons and press five in time; candidate iteratively tunes damper response.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1523 tests visual reaction, rapid reaching, and physical spring-button depression; candidate tests precision hex-key insertion, counterholding, fine rotation, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1523 requires five valid presses during one-second illumination windows within 120 seconds; candidate requires quantitative impact and retention criteria. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Timed reactive button pressing does not test adjustment or lock integrity.
